policy: No new performance runs; final-version reruns and retained earlier-stage measurements remain separate.
round_statistics: Median of each metric across the declared rounds; QPS variation=100*(max-min)/median; one round has no round variation.

units.throughput: QPS or MiB/s or Gb/s as labelled

single.version: Stage 1 working tree after linked AOF; consolidated as e9584bb, not rerun at 49b8d3d

pipeline.latency_scope: redis-benchmark native batch latency, not a per-command CPU time; do not divide by P

pipeline_stages.unoptimized_reason: No paired SET hotkey -O0 measurements archived; 2026-11-19 retune was explicitly built with -O2.

timing.write_seconds: key/value generation + serial HSET round trips + SAVE accepted replies; no per-SAVE completion wait
timing.drain_seconds: after final SAVE reply until SAVEINFO idle and pending=0
timing.hset_latency_ms: perf_counter_ns around Client.command(HSET): encoding/send/full reply; excludes generation and SAVE; nearest-rank P50/P99
timing.total_fork_ms: parent foreground fork time from SAVEINFO
timing.total_save_ms: child-reported cumulative snapshot function time; overlaps foreground writes
